name: migrate-to-solidrpc
description: Move an EVM application from one or more RPC providers to one SolidRPC integration with a safe comparison before cutover

interface.shortDescription: Move an EVM app to one SolidRPC integration
interface.longDescription: Audit the application's RPC usage, compare supported reads with SolidRPC, and move portable HTTPS JSON-RPC traffic to one SolidRPC integration without duplicating transactions or breaking provider-specific routes.
defaultPrompt: Add SolidRPC for manual read-only comparison without changing production routing.
Qualify and replace this application's portable HTTPS JSON-RPC provider with SolidRPC.
